title: Glad Collapsible Colander Strainer - 2L | Small Pasta Drainer for Kitchen, Vegetables, and Fruit | Round Plastic Foldable Draining Basket for Easy Storage,Grey
description:
About this item
VERSATILE STRAINER – A household essential for every kitchen. Perfect as a pasta strainer for spaghetti, fruit colander for washing berries, or drainer for cooking.
SAVES SPACE IN YOUR KITCHEN – Say goodbye to bulky colanders! This collapsible strainer folds down to only 1.3 inches high to take up minimal space in cupboards and drawers. Great compact tool for RVs and campers.
DURABLE DESIGN – Spaghetti strainer features durable handles for an easy carry, while the base is made with a rubber grip ring to prevent colander basket from skidding.
EASY TO CLEAN – Plastic colander is top-rack dishwasher safe. Its collapsible design makes it easy to fit into drying racks, which is ideal for apartments and small kitchens.
DIMENSIONS – Round, small colander measures 11.5 x 9.3 x 3.4 inches when fully expanded. Kitchen strainer has a capacity of 2 liters, or 8.4 cups.

I love this! I bought it to replace my old one I had for years. It's convenient and it's worth the money.Great strainerAs the title says, I use this to house mechanical filter media for aquarium water to use between 30% waterchanges. This technique mechanically filters waste from sand and gravel vacuuming, and decaying plant matter that the snails and fish haven't eaten.

I always start by testing the water parameters to ensure they are still optimal. Then, I siphon it through the multi-step, cut-to-shape filter media nestled in this collander. It's handel's rest on the rim of a bucket and the filtered water can be re-used, keeping my water bill lower.

I use coarse, medium, and fine spong filtration, followed by100 micron and then 50 micron flossing media, all cut to shape.

After I am finished with the maintenence, I rinse each layer of media individually, then the callander and let dry.

The collapsable feature is great at saving me space when storing between uses.Medium size, perfect for a 2 person household. reviews_1s:
This is not a work horse of a product. I bought it to replace a colander of 15 years that was cracking. This one not only cracked but it let go pasta that fell into the sink. It wasn't 6 months old and it split open and spilled angel hair pasta-8oz into the sink. I felt ok with buying a Glad product, I use their bags, etc. But this was very disappointing and now I need to start all over again. It was an ugly color anyway. I am going to look at OXO or maybe not a folding colander anymore!Click to play video
This strainer is horrible with a completely impractical design. I cook daily and have had this strainer for about 3 weeks. Not once has it worked the way I need it to.
1) The holes on the bottom are not properly placed. If sitting flat/within the sink, the holes on the bottom do not allow the water to flow out.
2) Collapses easily when full of water. Say goodbye to your noodles down the sink. It’s notorious for holding the water and collapses when the weight is too much. I’ve lost multiple pasta dinners due to this idiotic design.
3) It is now in the trash with a new design on the way.
4) Glad made me mad. :(Drainage holes are only on the bottom so poor drainage. Poor quality.Horrible. Broke within the first few uses. We’ve had these last years. Not this one.I bought this in September and it only lasted 6 months before tearing open along one of the seams. Disappointing.I thought the plastic edge felt flimsy when I opened it. After five uses draining noodles and vegetables, it broken on both sides.
